name: Admin Dashboard — stats, filters, recent sales

planSteps.description: Enter phone number 923001234567 and click Send Code
The admin dashboard loads showing greeting, date filter pills (All, Today, Yesterday, This Week, This Month), total sales card with amount, transactions count, and gross profit
The total sales amount updates to reflect today's sales only
Scroll down to the Recent Sales section
Recent Sales section shows customer name, date/time, Credit or Paid tag, and sale amount for each sale
Click on a recent sale card
The sale detail page opens showing customer info, items sold, payment summary, and actions (Share, Download, Void Sale)
